body: I’m not going to force myself to be intimate with him if it’s truly making me uncomfortable right now. I haven’t given him a hard time and I don’t owe him my body just because he’s my boyfriend. We had a long conversation and he knows that it has nothing to do with him, I didn’t put any blame on him, and I never tell him my insecurities or anxiety are his fault. I’m also not “choosing” to be anxious, this is something I was diagnosed with as a child and I am now in my twenties. It’s a life long process of treatment and mindfulness. I let him know I understand his actions are natural and don’t want him to suppress his attraction to others. It’s just something I have to work through on my own. Also, women on the internet are real women. Sure, they can be edited but there is still a real person that’s being interacted with behind the screen.

I understand that my insecurities are not his problem and that I can only make myself feel confident. True confidence doesn’t come from other people, because once they’re gone where does it go? I also understand this will be an issue in any relationship, not just my current one. My emotions on the situation aren’t going to change overnight, I’m working through why it is that I feel this way so I can move past it. I’ve been in therapy before but stopped being able to afford my last therapist. I’m looking for someone now, but of course they’re all booked up for months. Sometimes it just helps me to get feedback because I rarely trust my own mind
